jobs.description: Amazon Enterprise Engineering (EE) builds and operates the internal productivity platforms that Amazon employees rely on: Slack, M365, WorkDocs, Quip, Asana, and Kingpin. The team manages these platforms at Amazon scale and is now building a new layer on top of them, a self-service data governance platform that handles how employee data in these systems is accessed, classified, and audited for legal and privacy purposes. The platform spans the full stack: a consumer-facing request portal, a policy rules engine that treats Legal and Privacy requirements as tested software, a data classification pipeline operating at item level across millions of records, high-scale replication pipelines from source systems into a governed data lake, and a secure analytics environment. This is a greenfield build. The team is small and the problem is large. Engineers own significant surface area, work directly with Legal, Privacy, and Security stakeholders to translate policy requirements into enforcement logic, and build systems that will govern data access for every Amazon employee. Are you passionate about building software end-to-end? As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will design, develop, and deliver features that solve real problems in data governance, privacy enforcement, and secure access. You will work across the full software development lifecycle: from understanding the needs of Legal, Privacy, and Security stakeholders to deploying and operating production systems that govern data access for every Amazon employee. This role offers the opportunity to apply Generative AI where it creates real leverage. If you are a self-starter who thrives on turning ambiguous problems into clear, simple solutions, we want to hear from you. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement software solutions across the full development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, architecture, coding, testing, deployment, and operational support. - Write high-quality, maintainable code and actively participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to peers and mentoring team members on best practices. - Identify root causes of operational issues and implement permanent fixes, continuously improving system reliability and performance. - Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams to understand business needs and deliver the right technical solutions that balance short-term priorities with long-term architectural goals. - Evaluate and integrate new tools and approaches, including generative artificial intelligence capabilities, to improve team productivity and software quality. About the team Amazon Enterprise Engineering (EE) builds and operates the internal productivity and collaboration platforms that Amazon employees use every day: Slack, M365, WorkDocs, Quip, Asana, and Kingpin. The team owns both the platforms and the governance frameworks that protect employee data as it moves across those systems.

About the Team
You’ll be joining the Global People Operations organization to lead the Global Mobility & Immigration (GMI) function that owns strategy, operating model, and end-to-end delivery for mobility and immigration across the DoorDash brand ecosystem. GMI sits at the intersection of business enablement, employee experience, and compliance. The team partners closely with Legal, Talent Acquisition, People Business Partners, People Operations, and our external vendor ecosystem to keep global mobility and immigration compliant, scalable, and ready for what’s next as the business and its footprint continue to grow. This work shows up immediately and concretely: it determines whether critical transfers and international hires land on time, whether the company stays ahead of shifting immigration policy across jurisdictions, and whether employees relocating across borders get a support experience that matches the significance of that transition.
About the Role
This remote role can be located anywhere on the US East Coast.
We’re hiring a Director to lead our Global Mobility & Immigration (GMI) function. You’ll own GMI’s overall strategy, operating model, and performance end-to-end making sure GMI is both a strategic enabler of business growth and a disciplined steward of compliance risk, and a trusted partner to the stakeholders and leaders who depend on it. This is a rare opportunity to build one globally integrated GMI ecosystem across our brands — harmonizing the policies, roles, and ways of working that grew up independently across our brand ecosystem — while balancing compliance, scalability, and employee experience, and building the leadership bench and long-term team structure GMI needs to keep growing. You’ll lead and develop an existing, globally distributed team of mobility and immigration professionals, and serve as a strategic partner on the highest-priority cross-functional people operations initiatives. You will report to the Sr. Director, Head of Global People Operations and be part of the Global People Operations Leadership Team.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Define and drive GMI’s global strategy and priorities, keeping them tightly aligned with People Operations and the broader business strategy as both evolve.
Own and evolve one global GMI operating model harmonizing the policies, roles, and ways of working built independently across our brand ecosystem into a single, scalable, growth and M&A-ready function.
Lead and develop GMI’s pillar leaders, building a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning across a globally distributed team.
Own GMI’s vendor strategy evaluating, negotiating, and consolidating our immigration and relocation vendor relationships to control cost and quality as the program scales.
Drive the process improvement and technology roadmap for GMI modernizing how cases move from intake through visa filing and relocation so mobility and immigration run with greater efficiency and a more seamless experience as volume grows.
Serve as the final escalation point for high-risk or cross-functional mobility and immigration issues, and as a trusted advisor to Legal, Talent Acquisition, People Business Partners, and senior leadership — positioning GMI as a strategic partner to the business.
We’re excited about you because…
10+ years of progressive experience in global mobility and/or immigration, including several years leading teams and owning strategy across multiple jurisdictions ideally spanning the US, EMEA, and APAC.
A track record of building or scaling a global mobility/immigration function or operating model within a multinational, fast-paced environment, including developing and leading people leaders to build long-term organizational capability.
Strong cross-cultural fluency and change management experience, leading globally distributed teams and driving alignment across regions and brands.
Experience acting as a trusted strategic partner to senior stakeholders and cross-functional leaders including Legal, Talent Acquisition, and People Business Partners with sound judgment on high-risk, cross-functional escalations and the ability to translate ambiguity into clear priorities.
Curiosity about applying new tools, including AI, to improve efficiency, insights, and the employee experience within a global mobility and immigration function.

In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy. You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI. This role is based in Seoul, South Korea. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. jobs.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, against the challenging problems our customers face. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the existing workflows are, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be. No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to: - Meet with strategic customers to deeply understand their AI transformation goals and locate their biggest pain points, particularly around customer-facing and operational workflows powered by AI agents. - Own flagship deals end-to-end — from identifying the right use case to structuring commercial terms (including outcome-based pricing, license fees, and implementation arrangements) and driving them to close. - Embed yourself deeply inside strategic customers: act as a trusted partner with a provisioned account, spend meaningful time onsite, and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team. - Identify high-impact use cases through close engagement with customer problems and workflows, and collaborate with Forward Deployed Software Engineers to bring them to life. - Guide customers on best practices for deploying our products (e.g. ElevenAgents); including agent design, agent orchestration, production readiness to maximize adoption and impact. - Scope out potential applications in new industries and expand our AI solutions across different sectors globally. - Present the results of our work and proposals for future work to audiences ranging from technical teams to C-suite executives. - Collaborate with our Research teams to feed field insights back into ElevenLabs' platform and models, helping shape the roadmap. - Build and deliver compelling demos of ElevenAgents and our broader AI technology to new and existing customers. - Collaborate daily with customers' engineering and executive teams to ensure agents reach production and deliver measurable business outcomes. Requirements - 3+ years of experience working with customers in a technical capacity. Direct enterprise customer experience is preferred. - Experience in product development, delivery, and change management - Commercial instinct: comfort engaging in deal conversations, structuring value propositions, and navigating enterprise sales cycles alongside GTM partners. - Basic proficiency in Python and familiarity with API integration, sufficient to prototype, demo, and communicate credibly with engineering teams. - Excellent communication and problem-solving skills; particularly the ability to simplify complex technical concepts and structure clear logic in pursuit of optimal solutions. - A proven track record of taking ownership of complex, ambiguous projects and delivering results. - Adaptability to work across different customer environments, industries, and technical use cases. - Technical aptitude and familiarity with common LLM, tooling and AI agent frameworks. - Ability to creatively map enterprise use cases and workflows to AI systems LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in The Netherlands, with a preference of Amsterdam. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Dutch and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.description: Descrizione Il team Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) è fondamentale ad Amazon per monitorare tutte le attività operative: è grazie a questo team che viene garantito il corretto funzionamento di macchinari critici. In qualità di RME Technician, ti occuperai della manutenzione di una vasta gamma di macchinari e postazioni di lavoro, assicurando sempre il rispetto delle normative di salute e sicurezza. Aiuterai a tutelare la sicurezza dei colleghi, prevenendo fermi macchina. Il nostro team di RME ottimizza la disponibilità e la qualità dei nostri macchinari e migliora l’ambiente operativo nel complesso. Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica e Trasporti. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3. La retribuzione lorda per questa posizione è indicata di seguito. La retribuzione indicata corrisponde a un impiego a tempo pieno. Per un impiego a tempo parziale, la retribuzione sarà adeguata proporzionalmente. Il pacchetto retributivo di Amazon può includere ulteriori componenti retributive, ove applicabili. Il team di recruiting condividerà lo stipendio finale, in base ai requisiti specifici del ruolo e a eventuali integrazioni retributive applicabili in conformità al CCNL e al livello di inquadramento. Oltre ai benefici previsti dalla legge e quelli applicabili al CCNL di riferimento, potrebbero essere previsti ulteriori benefici aziendali, soggetti a termini aggiuntivi. Roma - 38,900€ lordi annui. Key job responsibilities Principali responsabilità • Interventi di manutenzione preventiva su un’ampia gamma di macchinari in sede. • Eseguire riparazioni di emergenza e diagnosi dei guasti nei magazzini di distribuzione. • Utilizzo di strumenti all’avanguardia per massimizzare l’efficacia dei macchinari. • Conformità a tutte le normative e prassi in materia di salute e sicurezza. • Favorire lo sviluppo e l’avanzamento di chi partecipa ai programmi di apprendistato nelle nostre sedi. • Sovraintendere a progetti di miglioramento continuo e implementare procedure chiave in una gamma di sedi europee. A day in the life La giornata tipo I nostri RME Technician operano sul campo, in modo da intervenire prontamente nell’eventualità di problemi ai macchinari. A intervalli prestabiliti, eseguirai una serie di interventi di manutenzione preventiva sui macchinari delle nostre sedi, per assicurarne il corretto funzionamento. In qualità di RME Technician, interverrai prontamente in caso di guasti, investigandone le cause e implementando soluzioni in maniera tempestiva. Inoltre, indicherai possibili miglioramenti a lungo termine da apportare per scongiurare problematiche in futuro. Affiancando i colleghi senior, ti occuperai della manutenzione ordinaria, come la tinteggiatura o l’idraulica, con il supporto di professionisti esterni se necessario. Il tuo lavoro sarà organizzato su diversi turni, per assicurare assistenza 24 ore su 24, in modo da consentire ad Amazon di effettuare le consegne con la velocità che ci contraddistingue.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 리테일 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 유지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성(Always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술(High-tech), 초연결사회(Hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.
쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.
분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면
,
지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요

jobs.description: Job summary Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day.
